name: Semnan Space Center (Imam Khomeini Spaceport)
best_known_for: Iran's orbital launch site: Safir put Omid, Iran's first home-built satellite, in orbit in 2009
credit: Iran's main spaceport, 50 km southeast of Semnan, operated by the Iranian Space Agency; it includes an older circular pad used by Safir and the larger Imam Khomeini Space Launch Terminal used by Simorgh. The first Safir orbital attempt, with a dummy satellite, was on 17 August 2008, and Omid reached orbit on 2 February 2009. Facts from Wikipedia (Semnan Space Center, Safir, Omid) and the IISS analysis of October 2026; coordinates are the Semnan Space Center point on Wikipedia (the Safir pad area).
